title: Hayati Pro Max Blue Fusion Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Blue Fusion is a vibrant trio of fruity flavours, blending juicy Blueberry, sweet Strawberry, and a splash of zesty Orange. The result is a well-rounded, tangy-sweet vape that layers soft berry notes with a citrus edge, offering a bright and refreshing flavour with every puff. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers faster nicotine satisfaction, and a smooth, comfortable throat hit—ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG blend offers a consistent balance between clean flavour and discreet vapour. Inspired by Hayati’s popular disposable range, the Pro Max Nic Salt collection transforms those bestselling flavours into convenient, longer-lasting 10ml bottles—available in 10mg and 20mg strengths.
